name: Ferienwohnung Limmer Tobias
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Limmer Tobias welcomes guests with a warm atmosphere, comfortable rooms, and pleasing mountain views.

Lake Thiersee for swimming and hiking paths ascending Mount Pendling are close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Limmer Tobias in Thiersee offers relaxing holidays and mountain nature in Kufsteinerland.
